title: bmo-chat provider library
what: The provider library bmo-chat publishes, which this service stands on: the provider contract, the receiver link, the dialect trait and the wire types every hand-over is built from.

title: Receiver hand-over
what: Every call this repository makes on the receiver: a message, edit or history handed on, a gathered patch, a room's listened state and its rooms, and word of changed profile pictures.
